usage.callShape: GET https://stabletravel.dev/api/flightaware/flights/search?query=<FlightAware-search-syntax> (required query param, e.g. query=-airline UAL)
usage.outputShape: body.flights[] (array of flight objects with .ident, .ident_iata, .origin.{code_iata,name,city}, .destination.{code_iata,name,city}, .status, .actual_off/.scheduled_off times); pagination at body.links.next and body.num_pages
quirks: The query param uses FlightAware AeroAPI search syntax, not a plain text search. Use operators like -airline UAL, -idents UAL123, or -latlong 'minlat minlon maxlat maxlon'. A bare keyword may return no/empty results.
Response can be large (~33KB for one airline); each flight includes a long waypoints[] lat/lon array.
usage.guide: Pay-per-call x402 flight search ($0.10 on Base USDC). Call GET https://stabletravel.dev/api/flightaware/flights/search with a required `query` parameter using FlightAware search syntax — e.g. `-airline UAL` for all United flights, `-idents UAL1526` for a specific flight, or `-latlong "..."` for a bounding box. The response is synchronous JSON; read the results from body.flights[], where each flight has ident/ident_iata, origin and destination objects (code_iata, name, city), status, and scheduled/actual times.
